acceptance_cases.expect: clone receives new ID/version and exact source provenance; later source edit does not change clone
each exact source/version is separately attributed and remix has one independent identity
reuse is reauthorized and privacy-filtered; protected participant/GM-only material is excluded; no backward Campaign sync exists
source and destination authorization are independently required; authority does not transfer between Campaigns
destination cannot infer protected target details; reference is marked unavailable/unresolved without leakage
creator can explicitly map an inherited source reference to an authorized destination object with provenance
derivative remains unchanged and receives advisory compare/manual-adapt options only
new candidate is generated from exact newer source plus recorded transform decisions and requires compare/apply
existing instances do not change; future instances record new exact template version
compatibility warning is evidence-backed and advisory unless an owning-domain incorporation operation requires compatibility
exact CSW-07 document/branch/revision/span provenance is retained; source revision is not mutated
CSW semantic structure remains pre-authoritative and must use CSW-05/D28 handoff before becoming governed Adventure truth
same idempotency key yields the same derivative receipt rather than a second derivative
candidate is flagged stale/review-required rather than silently recomputed/applied
AI sees only authorized source projection and returns candidate material; cannot publish/promote/mutate
all lineage, mapping, compare and resolution operations are available through ordered/list/text UI without graph/drag/color dependence
